RESOLUTION NO.
ENTITLED:
"A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING THE CITY OF CHEYENNE'S
APPLICATION FOR TRANSPORTATION ALTERNATIVES PROGRAM
(TAP)FUNDS FOR CONTINUATION OF THE GREEN WAY SYSTEM,
SPECIFICALLY A SOFT SURFACE TRAIL IN SOUTHEAST CHEYENNE."
WHEREAS, the Transportation Alternatives Program(TAP)funds ten different project types
and Cheyenne intends to apply under the project type of“Pedestrian and Bicycle Facilities"; and
WHEREAS, the project was identified in the Cheyenne On-Street Bicycle Plan&Greenway
Plan Update (2012); and
WHEREAS, the project involves installing 2.5miles of soft surface trail, composed of %"
minus crusher fines, in southeast Cheyenne.The trail will be located south of I-80 and extend east
along the abandoned B NSF railroad line, runningfrom South Industrial Road to the Dry Creek
Wastewater Treatment Plant and connecting north to the Greenway along HR Ranch Road; and
WHEREAS, the pathwill provide an alternative trail experience for equestrians, pedestrians
and bicyclists; and
WHEREAS, this project is estimated to cost$250,000 and the City of Cheyenne will askfor a
grant of $200,000(80% ofthe project cost).The City will provide 20% of the project cost, or$50,000,
from 6"Penny Sales Tax funds; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne and the Cheyenne Metropolitan Planning Organization
within the Cheyenne Urban Area which included an opportunity for public input; and
WHEREAS, the proposed project is listed in the Federal Fiscal Year 2016-2019MPO
Transportation Improvement Program(TIP) approved bythe Policy, Technical and Citizens
Committees and submitted to the Wyoming Department of Transportation for inclusion in the
Wyoming Statewide Transportation Improvement Plan(STIP); and
WHEREAS, plans and cost estimates forthe proposed project have been prepared and
reviewed by the City of Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne supports this proposed project and pledges thelocal cash
match; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne will follow allfederal, state, and local requirements
necessaryto complete the proposed project; and
WHEREAS, the proposed project could be ready for construction within the Federal FY 2016.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE
CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING:
1.That the City of Cheyenne agrees with and supports the application for Transportation
Alternatives Program(TAP)fundsfor continuation of the Greenway system, specifically a soft
surface trail in southeast Cheyenne, presented to the Wyoming Department of Transportation as
aneligible activity for TAP funding, and
2.That the Mayor is authorized to sign the grant agreement if this grant request is approved.
PRESENTED, READ AND ADOPTED THIS
DAY OF JUNE 2015.
Richard L. Kaysen, Mayor
(Seal)
ATTEST:
Carol Inlekofer, City Clerk
